name: Republic Wire Inc
old_description: Since its humble beginnings in a 3000 sq ft warehouse in 1982, Republic Wire has grown to over 400,000 sq ft and continues to grow. Republic Wire was founded on the principals of service for our customers. Hard work, customer loyalty and the ability to manufacture a quality product are Republic Wire’s key ingredients for success.
about:
Republic Wire Inc. began operations in Cincinnati, Ohio, in January 1982. Founder Ron Rosenbeck, who had been in the copper industry since 1973, started the company in a 3,000-square-foot warehouse. The business remains under his ownership as CEO.

The company manufactures a range of copper and aluminum wiring products, including bare copper, THHN, XHHW, USE, NM-B, TFFN, TW, polyweatherproof, tinned copper, PV, UF, MHF, URD, SER, SEU, and aluminum variants. Production uses electrolytically refined 99% pure copper insulated with polyvinyl chloride, with in-line testing for imperfections. The operation now occupies a 350,000-square-foot modern production facility in West Chester Township, Ohio.

Republic Wire serves electrical wholesale distributors, utility distributors, Rural Utilities Service (RUS) cooperatives, investor-owned utilities, and municipalities nationwide. Its product line is designed to meet the needs of these customer segments with an emphasis on inventory availability and fill rates.

The company was founded on principles of customer service, hard work, and loyalty, with a commitment to delivering high-quality products on time. Republic Wire emphasizes its USA manufacturing and a team-based approach to quality and service.
